evidence: Kernel-proved retained-anchor class bound and exact physical history transport; concrete spherical program consumers.
proved: Equal exterior and equal colours on a cycle-breaking set imply a Kempe path fixing both.
Any pairwise unreachable family of full extensions of the same exterior has cardinality at most q^|K|.
For one retained vertex and four colours the bound is four, with no hidden-region size bound.
Jointly guarded histories on the retained graph are equivalent to actual histories fixing the original exterior.
program_scope: A frozen facial triangle has two feasible anchor colours in distinct classes. A six-cycle has two feasible anchor colours in one class; its accepted transition reconstructs into two actual switches while fixing all 156 exterior vertices. Both use the same complete 162-vertex sphere. Exhaustive checks on two and four full local assignments agree with both partitions. Concrete instances are program checked, not kernel certified.
scope: The class bound does not make all anchor colours or transitions feasible. No uniform bound on anchor count for arbitrary maps, ordinary smaller-map reduction, global geometric supply, closure of compact joint constraints under arbitrary composition, or net complete-proof cost saving is established.
